name: Baytown Shopping Center
summary: Baytown Shopping Center is a 95,941-square-foot community center anchored by Sky Zone, Goodwill, and Legacy Community Health, strategically positioned on high-traffic Garth Road near major employers including the Exxon Mobil Baytown Refinery. The center serves a strong daytime population of over 73,000 with a practical mix of retail, services, and dining options.
demographics: The Baytown Shopping Center serves a diverse middle-income market with a strong daytime population of over 73,000 within a 3-mile radius, driven by the nearby 7,000+ employees at the Exxon Mobil Baytown Refinery and staff from the 230-bed Houston Methodist Baytown Hospital. The trade area features households with an average income of $81,674 within 3 miles, attracting working families and industrial workers seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs, services, and dining. The center's tenant mix of value-oriented retailers like Goodwill, discount liquor stores, and service businesses reflects the practical shopping preferences of blue-collar workers and budget-conscious families in this industrial Houston suburb.
description: Baytown Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination strategically located on Garth Road in Baytown, Texas, serving the eastern Houston metropolitan area. Spanning 95,941 square feet, this open-air center occupies a prime position in Baytown's major retail corridor between I-10 and Highway 146, benefiting from over 32,000 vehicles daily on Garth Road and 17,000 on Rollingbrook Drive. The center is anchored by Sky Zone Indoor Trampoline Park, Goodwill, and Legacy Community Health, complemented by national tenants including Firestone, Pizza Hut, and State Farm Insurance, creating a diverse mix of retail, services, dining, and entertainment options. Its strategic location near the massive 3,400-acre Exxon Mobil Baytown Refinery, which employs over 7,000 people, and the 230-bed Houston Methodist Baytown Hospital ensures a robust daytime population of more than 73,000 within three miles. Managed by Brixmor Property Group, one of the nation's largest open-air shopping center REITs, the center continues to serve the practical everyday needs of Baytown's working families and the surrounding Harris County community with convenient access and ample visibility.
